2d8a9a714284cf1a53668833da9794110cd9ba1e
docs(product-view): fix contradictory ?? contract in renderVariationAttribute
---BODY---
The JSDoc said `??` "only" treats undefined as absent, then said null
also falls through - a literal contradiction, since nullish coalescing
treats both null and undefined as nullish by definition. The practical
guidance (returning null does not render nothing) was already correct;
only the false premise about the operator itself needed correcting.

Refs SFCC-91

=====
=====
7139687d8844556e9a1d190becb71e0e7b9fb11b
feat(pdp): render colour variations through ZimmColourSwatchGroup
---BODY---
Passes renderVariationAttribute to the main ProductView, handling
id === 'color' and returning undefined for everything else so size falls
through to the base rendering unchanged. Resolves each variation's swatch
image URL (disBaseLink || link) at the page so the ui-kit components hold
no SFCC shape knowledge - mirroring how product-view's own extracted
rendering resolves the same image for the base swatch it replaces.

attr.name and each value's value are coerced with ?? '' at the mapping
boundary: both are typed optional on the shared SfccVariationAttribute/
SfccVariationValue types, while ZimmColourSwatchGroup's props require
non-optional strings. A real colour value always carries both, so this is
a type-safety fallback, not a functional change.

The attribute id stays "color": Australian spelling applies to
Zimmermann-authored identifiers, not to SFCC attribute ids.

Set and bundle child ProductView instances are untouched. Their own
colour variation attributes, when present, keep the base default
rendering - passing this same slot into that layout has no confirmed
Figma treatment behind it, so it isn't done here.

Refs SFCC-91

=====
=====
b16298e379d1d75269ff4fe9cb762f9c0d91e45c
feat(ui-kits): add ZimmColourSwatchGroup molecule
---BODY---
Renders the PDP colour picker. Multiple populated colours render as
swatches with the current one indicated (AC 2, AC 3); one colour renders
as the text label "Colour: Bay Blue" with no swatches (AC 1); a variation
whose index image is not populated is filtered out before either branch
and is never surfaced (AC 5).

AC 5 is content population, not stock availability - a distinct condition
from base product-view's disabled={!orderable}, and a filtered variation
is not rendered disabled, it is not rendered at all. The filter lives
here rather than on the PDP page so the behaviour is provable from this
component's own folder.

More than four populated colours paginate in fixed 4-wide windows with
prev/next chevrons, per the Figma design's own interaction annotation.
The visible page always tracks the actual selection - both on mount and
if the selection changes on an already-mounted instance - rather than
always starting at page one, since a selection beyond the first page
would otherwise render with nothing checked and nothing keyboard-focusable.

The component's own outer width is capped to the same reserved four-swatch
footprint pagination uses, unconditionally, so a long colour name always
has something to truncate against regardless of what the eventual PDP
page does or doesn't constrain.

Roving tabindex and arrow-key focus movement match base swatch-group, so
the group remains a single tab stop.

Takes all data as props; useIntl only, per the components.md exemption.
No swatch-group, image-gallery, hook or translations change.

Touches TIER 2 overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts (two lines) to
register the recipe, in the same commit as the recipe for the reason
given in the previous commit.

Refs SFCC-91

=====
=====
6631e05a1e8bad054145fb16f7c0bcce7000fe9b
fix(ui-kits): keep focus ring visible on adjacent colour swatches
---BODY---
_focusVisible now sets position: relative and zIndex: 1 on
ZimmColourSwatch. Swatches sit with zero gap between them, so a focused
swatch's outward-drawn outline had its right edge painted over by the
next sibling's opaque background - normal document flow paints later
siblings on top, and neither element had a stacking context of its own.
zIndex alone is empirically sufficient for a flex item per spec, but
position: relative is kept too so the rule holds if this component is
ever composed outside a flex parent.

Adds a regression test asserting the resolved position/zIndex via
getComputedStyle - mutation-verified to fail with position: static
before this fix.

Refs SFCC-91

=====
=====
ab04241807dc5b17f0dfd1409617cec5475c7119
feat(ui-kits): add ZimmColourSwatch atom
---BODY---
A single colour swatch: the variation's index image in a 48x72 box,
rendered as a react-router Link when an href is supplied so selecting a
colour updates the URL without a document load.

Height comes from aspectRatio 2/3 on var(--zimm-scale-1200) rather than a
72px literal - no --zimm-* token exists at 72px and theme/foundation/ is
Tier 1.

Selected is a bottom-only border, not a full box outline - the Figma
export is unambiguous on this. Focus mirrors zimmNavItem.css.ts's existing
outline/outlineOffset pattern rather than replicating Figma's asymmetric
per-side ring geometry, which reads as that one frame's export noise.

Does not carry base product-view's backgroundColor={name.toLowerCase()}.
That tints behind a missing image using the colour's display name as a
CSS keyword ("Ivory" resolves, "Bay Blue" does not); this component is
only rendered for variations that have an index image, so there is
nothing to tint. A test pins the absence.

Recipe key is namespaced ZimmColourSwatch - an unnamespaced key would
deep-merge the base SFCC recipe (recipeGuards.test.ts).

Touches TIER 2 overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts (two lines: one
import, one key) to register the recipe. The recipe, the component and
the registration are one commit because recipeParts.test.ts fails on a
recipe with no sibling index.tsx.

Refs SFCC-91

=====
=====
9f46912b5797d09fe3d85d078b69ebd65c8513bc
feat(product-view): add renderVariationAttribute slot for per-attribute rendering
---BODY---
Adds one optional prop so a caller can replace the rendering of a single
variation attribute, leaving the others on the base markup. Mirrors the
renderHeader slot added in 227171e: type on ProductViewProps, fall-through
at the call site, base body moved verbatim into a new default function.

The slot is per-attribute rather than per-block deliberately. product-view
renders colour and size through the same loop and the same base SwatchGroup,
distinguished only by variant={id === 'color' ? 'circle' : 'square'}. A
whole-block slot would pull the size selector - which has its own separate
Figma design and its own story - into a colour-only change.

Fall-through is on undefined. Returning null also falls through and is not
a way to render nothing; documented on the prop.

The file header's claim of "exactly one additive optional prop" is
corrected to name both. No other change: no reformatting, no comment
removal, no type tightening.

Refs SFCC-91

=====

=== commit 6631e05 file list (atom fix) ===
    
    _focusVisible now sets position: relative and zIndex: 1 on
    ZimmColourSwatch. Swatches sit with zero gap between them, so a focused
    swatch's outward-drawn outline had its right edge painted over by the
    next sibling's opaque background - normal document flow paints later
    siblings on top, and neither element had a stacking context of its own.
    zIndex alone is empirically sufficient for a flex item per spec, but
    position: relative is kept too so the rule holds if this component is
    ever composed outside a flex parent.
    
    Adds a regression test asserting the resolved position/zIndex via
    getComputedStyle - mutation-verified to fail with position: static
    before this fix.

8 CREATE + 3 MODIFY + 3 registry = 14/14. Nothing falls outside those three buckets — no "something else entirely" finding.

## 2–3. Manifest match, file by file

- **8 CREATE**: all show `A` status (`git diff --name-status`), exactly the 8 paths named in plan.md §3, no extras in either folder (atom = 4 files, molecule = 4 files).
- **`overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`**: diff is exactly 2 imports + 2 keys (`ZimmColourSwatch`, `ZimmColourSwatchGroup`) — "one pair per new recipe," nothing else touched in the file.
- **`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`**: one new import (`ZimmColourSwatchGroup`, comment-tagged `// SFCC-91 — PDP colour swatches.`) and one new `renderVariationAttribute` prop on a single `<ProductView>` call, sitting beside the existing `renderHeader`/`addToCart` props on that same call — confirmed it's the main PDP call, not a set/bundle instance (single diff hunk, no other `<ProductView>` touched in the file).
- **`overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx`**: full diff reviewed — JSDoc header updated to describe two props instead of one, `renderVariationAttribute` added to `ProductViewProps` + destructured with no default (so it stays `undefined` unless supplied), and the original inline `variationAttributes.map(...)` body extracted **verbatim** into `renderDefaultVariationAttribute`, called via `renderVariationAttribute?.(attr) ?? renderDefaultVariationAttribute(attr)`. Line-by-line comparison of the extracted function against the original inline block shows identical logic — a pure extraction, no behaviour change. This matches "one optional prop + default + call site + header doc fix" exactly.
- **Registry churn**: `.claude/registry/{components,hooks,pages}.md` all carry the auto-generated `Last updated` timestamp bump plus new rows for the two components. `hooks.md`/`components.md` also show unrelated consumer-count drops (e.g. `App` 8→5, `useCurrentBasket`/`useMultiSite`/etc. down by 1–3) — these are not caused by this branch (confirmed zero lines touched under `overrides/app/hooks/`); the registry's `Last updated` was stale at `2026-08-28`, predating the SFCC-194 merge that produced this branch's own base commit 269d5d4, so this is the first regen since then surfacing prior drift, not new scope. Per the brief, this is expected/automatic and not a finding.

## 4. Excluded paths — checked across the entire committed branch history

`git diff 269d5d4..HEAD -- <path>` returned **0 lines** for every one of: `overrides/app/theme/foundation/`, `overrides/app/components/swatch-group/`, `overrides/app/components/image-gallery/`, `translations/`, `overrides/app/static/translations/`, `.storybook/`, `overrides/app/hooks/`, `.claude/rules/`, `.claude/skills/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CODEOWNERS`, `config/`, `.github/workflows/`. All genuinely untouched by any commit on this branch.

**Separate, non-commit finding — working tree is not actually clean.** `git status` shows 5 unstaged, uncommitted modifications right now: `translations/en-GB.json`, `translations/en-US.json`, `overrides/app/static/translations/compiled/en-GB.json`, `en-US.json`, `en-XA.json` — none of this appears in `269d5d4..HEAD`, so it does not affect the branch-diff verdict, but it directly touches two of the plan's absolute-excluded paths and contradicts the "tree clean" framing given at the start of this audit. Tracing it: these edits (a new `header.button.assistive_msg.search` key, `product_view.label.quantity` → `"Quantity:"`) match content from commits `7b7c088`/`f9c6c74` on a **different, sibling branch** for the same story, `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection` (confirmed via `git branch --all --contains`; diverged from this branch at merge-base `04039a9`, and built colour swatches at a different path, `overrides/app/components/product-view/colourSwatches/`, later abandoned in favour of the current `ui-kits/atoms|molecules` structure). The reflog shows that branch was checked out earlier in this session, and its uncommitted deltas rode along on the subsequent checkout of `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches`. **This must be stashed or discarded before any further commit/push on this branch** — left alone, a routine `git add -A` would silently pull two excluded paths into the PR. I have not touched it, per instruction.

## 5. Tier re-derivation (independent of the plan's own labels)

- `ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/**`, `ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/**` — CODEOWNERS L176 (`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/` → both squads) and L186 (co-located `**/*.css.ts` → both squads, last-match-wins). **Tier 3, plain ownership, no approver gate.** Consistent with `overrideStyling.md`'s co-location pattern.
- `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` — protectedFiles.md "Theme Component Styles" + CODEOWNERS L117 (`tier-2-approvers`+`tier-1-approvers`). **Tier 2, confirmed** — matches the plan's own label.
- `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` — absent from frozenFiles.md, protectedFiles.md, and CODEOWNERS entirely. **Genuinely unowned/untiered, confirmed** — matches the plan.
- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` — CODEOWNERS L162, "TIER 3: Squad B ownership" → `@ZimmermannAU/pwa-squad-b`. **Tier 3, squad-b, confirmed** — matches the plan.
  - Pre-existing doc conflict found (not introduced by this branch, not a plan error): `.claude/rules/squadA.md` and `.claude/rules/squadB.md` (both stamped "Draft squad split — scope can still change") both claim `product-detail/` for Squad A, contradicting CODEOWNERS. This exact conflict is already self-documented in `overrideStyling.md`'s "Known gaps" section. CODEOWNERS is the real, GitHub-enforced routing per AGENTS.md's own stated philosophy, and the plan followed it correctly — flagging only because point 5 asked me to re-derive independently rather than trust the label.
- `.claude/registry/{components,hooks,pages}.md` — absent from frozenFiles.md, protectedFiles.md, CODEOWNERS. The Tier-1 `.claude/**` designation is scoped in practice to `.claude/rules/` and `.claude/settings.json`, not the whole tree. **Untiered, auto-generated, confirmed not a Tier 1 hit.**

No tier misclassification in the plan itself.

## 6. Commit message attribution

`git log 269d5d4..HEAD` (6 commits: `9f46912`, `ab04241`, `6631e05`, `b16298e`, `7139687`, `2d8a9a7`) — grepped full subject+body for `claude|coderabbit|co-authored|anthropic|generated with|ai-generated`: **zero matches.** All 6 authored by `Marcel Angelo Navarro <marcel.a.n.navarro@accenture.com>`. Rework commits verified in-scope: `6631e05` (atom fix) touches only `zimmColourSwatch/index.test.tsx` + `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` (already-planned CREATE paths) + registry churn; `2d8a9a7` (doc fix) touches only `product-view/index.tsx` (already-planned MODIFY path) + registry churn. Neither introduces a new path.

**Separate, out-of-scope finding:** the sibling branch `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection` (pushed to `origin`) carries `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>` on commits `f9c6c74` and `7b7c088` — a real violation of this project's no-AI-attribution rule, but on a different branch than the one assigned for this audit. Flagging since it's the same Jira story and still live on origin; not part of this verdict.

## Verdict

**IN SCOPE** — for `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches` (269d5d4..HEAD): all 8 CREATE + 3 MODIFY files match plan.md §3 exactly, all 14 excluded paths are untouched across every commit, every touched file's tier was independently re-derived and matches the plan's claims, and all 6 commit messages are attribution-clean and human-authored. Registry churn (3 files) is expected/automatic.

Two items outside that verdict need the developer's attention before this branch goes further:
1. **Working tree is not clean** — 5 uncommitted files touching `translations/` and `overrides/app/static/translations/` (absolute-excluded paths), contaminated from the abandoned sibling branch. Stash or discard before the next commit/push.
2. **`origin/feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection`** carries two commits (`f9c6c74`, `7b7c088`) with Claude `Co-Authored-By` trailers — a live rule violation on a different branch, surfaced for awareness only.
